description:
At Apple, we work together to build products and services that make a difference in people’s lives. That work is possible because people with different backgrounds, experiences, and ideas come together to solve difficult problems. Everyone has an opportunity to contribute, learn, and help shape what comes next.

This role is within Apple’s Security Engineering & Architecture organization on a team that builds and operates infrastructure used by security engineers across Apple. Our work includes production services, compute platforms, developer tools, and automation that support how teams build, test, analyze, and secure Apple products at scale.

Description
In this role, you will design, develop, and operate software and infrastructure used by security engineering teams. You will collaborate with engineers across the organization to understand their needs and translate them into reliable, reusable platform capabilities.

Your work may include distributed services, APIs, command-line tools, deployment automation, observability, and integrations with other engineering systems. You will help improve the reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency of the services we provide.

Minimum qualifications
BS/MS in Computer Science or 5+ years equivalent experience
Ability to demonstrate strong problem solving and logic in backend programming
Experienced with building cloud services and distributed systems at scale
Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of cross-organizational projects

Preferred qualifications
Excellent Swift, Objective-C, or Go programming skills
Experience with high-availability operations management, including deployment automation and rollback strategies
Familiarity with security architecture design and review
Effective communication of complex technical concepts
Track record of shipping customer-facing services or products
5+ years of experience with multi-functional technical leadership
